messages:
leah-cs: FYI — Saffron Labs renewal window next week. They want 9 months instead of 12, asking for 12% off. Onboarding is ~70% (KMS question + data-schema validation). Procurement needs our EU vendor code and PO. DocuSign blocked by their infosec. Need pricing confirmation + signature fallback. cc @sam-fin @nora-legal

mike-se: What seat count are we talking? Any ramp plan?

leah-cs: Starting 10 seats, expect +5 in month 2. Proposed start 2026-04-15.

sam-fin: Baseline $150/seat/month. Math: 10 * 150 * 9 = 13,500 pre-discount. At 12% discount => 11,880 total. If billed monthly with discount: 150*10*(1-0.12)=1320/mo. Need PO and payment method to finalize.

nora-legal: We can approve 9-month addendum. For KMS: we'll accept customer-managed KMS if they sign the KMS addendum and provide attestation. For e-sign: add clause: "If third-party e-sign is restricted, customer may upload a wet-signed PDF to secure portal." Also need signatory name & title on PO.

leah-cs: Customer confirmed they'll provide PO from EU entity and will wire payment. They prefer the 12% discount.

violet-enable: I'll prepare two enablement sessions week after sign and update first-week runbook with data validation checklist. Need access to sample schema by 2026-04-10.

sam-fin: Wire is fine. Please send PO + wire instructions to billing@redwood.com. Finance will stamp once vendor code & billing entity match invoicing.

mike-se: Recommend we allow temporary Dedicated capacity during ramp to maintain latency SLAs.

nora-legal: Drafting 9-month addendum and KMS addendum now, will post in contract thread.

esign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0xF12 created by leah-cs — Status: blocked (policy)

leah-cs: I'll ask them to wet-sign, upload to portal, and send PO by EOD Tue. Plan recap: 1) Legal to post addenda by EOD; 2) Finance to confirm invoice/wire instructions; 3) Enablement scheduled week after sign; 4) Mike to provision temporary Dedicated seats if needed; 5) Leah to update renewal tracker when PO is in. Closing here once signed docs uploaded. Thanks all.
